paragraphs: I help independent authors turn finished manuscripts into polished, professional, publication-ready books. Some are first-time authors holding their very first proof copy; others are established writers who simply need a reliable pair of hands before launch day.

My focus is nonfiction, self-help and personal development, children's books, workbooks, journals, educational materials and practical guides. I also take on fiction and other genres when the manuscript is a good fit.
Every book gets the same care: clean typography, consistent styles, and files that meet the platform's requirements, so nothing stands between your words and your readers.

process.title: Four simple steps to a *ready-to-publish* book.

steps.title: Send your manuscript
steps.text: Share your Word or Google Docs file, your trim size, the formats you need and your launch date.

steps.title: Get a clear quote
steps.text: I review the manuscript and send a quote and a timeline for the services your book needs.

steps.title: Edit, format, review
steps.text: I polish and lay out your book, then send proofs so you can review every page and request changes.

steps.title: Publish with confidence
steps.text: You receive final print PDFs and ebook files, ready to upload to KDP, IngramSpark and beyond.
